issue_request: FHIR-29655 was a Published/Persuasive R5 technical correction asking for Questionnaire.date to say 'Date last formally published' instead of 'Date last changed', because the original date search parameter text referred to questionnaire publication date and server last-change time is represented by _lastUpdated.
initial_application: The issue was applied by c998725176, which changed the Questionnaire.date short description in source/questionnaire/structuredefinition-Questionnaire.xml to 'Date last formally published'. That historical commit is reachable from the current branch and from v5.0.0; later canonical-resource and pattern-alignment commits changed the date semantics and short text again.
additional_context: FHIR-37858 was later Published/Persuasive for R5 and explicitly separated CanonicalResource.date from publication date: date now means last significant change, while publication date belongs in the MetadataResource publication-date mechanism. Questionnaire is active in source/fhir.ini, uses the MetadataResource template, and the current Questionnaire.date definition/comment say the date is last significantly changed, may be present before publication, and is not the server last-modified date. The current Questionnaire date search parameter also describes the last significant change date rather than publication date.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit and intentionally left source unchanged. Reinstating 'Date last formally published' would conflict with the later controlling canonical-resource decision and would make Questionnaire diverge from its MetadataResource date semantics.
